summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K as a monthly disclosure of UK FCA announcements for August 2026. The filing reports routine PDMR transactions: a grant of 9,172 performance share units to an officer (vesting March 2029) and small share acquisitions by the CFO and General Counsel under share plans on Nasdaq. It also notes block admission applications and total voting rights disclosures, reflecting ordinary corporate governance and compensation events. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, activism, or restructuring is present. The filing is purely administrative, reporting standard insider equity transactions and capital disclosures under UK and SEC rules.
